cases.behavior: Requirement ledger, role matrix and current backend reuse map agree; no injected overview or duplicate authority.
Current PCE2 affected work is mapped/adopted/superseded through supported means without unrelated or dirty-work loss.
Cross-authority contracts are versioned and producer receipts identify separate authorities; no foreign native task dependencies.
Returned authorized payloads and provenance survive restart; audit correlation is retained without hidden reasoning or tokens.
Concurrent alias collision, expiry, tombstones, backup/restore and namespace handling never rebind an old alias.
Hint lookup enforces scope, deduplicates content, preserves exact spans and reports stale/expired/omitted inputs.
Retention pins active jobs, recent answer evidence and child packets; GC never deletes required live input.
Negative/discovery and volatile evidence cannot reuse solely by seed/source-file hash; changed dependencies invalidate correctly.
Overview provides source-backed purpose/architecture/relative paths and catalog when project absent; no automatic injection.
Delta reports material changes and unavailable baselines without empty-success lies or heartbeat noise.
Frontier exposes compact and scoped deep coordination with current applicability, no repeated whole-project dossier.
Observer multi-file read preserves exact content, per-file errors/ranges and immutable revision semantics.
Absolute/traversal/drive/UNC paths, symlink components/Git blobs and source-read races are rejected or accurately flagged.

Search retrieves exact typed task, gate, interface, decision, run, packet and investigation identifiers through existing canonical lookup, handles ambiguity and scoped access, and does not invoke fuzzy/lexical retrieval unnecessarily or filesystem discovery; no public find or competing local inspector.

Search combines semantic/source mechanisms, discovers paths, preserves live fallback and correctly handles exact phrases/symbols. These discovery behaviors remain unchanged when exact typed lookup is absorbed; native/local filesystem discovery continues through find/rg/Git.
Evidence distinguishes registered/unrun/failed/current/frozen/stale gates and does not call source mentions proof.
History handles real Git ancestry/merge ranges and every advertised selector; no lexical SHA ordering or inferred causality.
Machine is available to all roles, reports volatile source times, and cannot launch probes or mutate leases.
Applied-skill guidance and notes surface with attributed compact summaries and authoritative follow-up locators.
Typed multi-hop dependents traversal has witness chains, cycle/fanout handling and correct relation direction.
C++ provider reuse, Python imports, manifest/generation, Markdown references and language-neutral export adapter have honest relation types.
Cross-project package/interface versions resolve through registered relationships, not names alone; inaccessible edges remain explicit.
Unchanged-file import resolution changes, new/untracked consumers, renames/deletions, configuration and watcher loss invalidate coverage.
Paths mode avoids full source reads; snippets match graph source identities or return stale/partial; lexical candidates do not explode closure.
Warm repeated queries reuse unaffected fragments; new provider plug-in/export fixture integrates without a new public tool.
Admission is durable before acceptance and queued work drains after caller disconnect without a later poll triggering execution.
Soft threshold three returns accepted ID plus do-not-wait guidance; hard limits/storage failure never falsely claim acceptance.
Request-ID retries and polling do not duplicate work or acquire GPUs; semantically related questions reuse context without accidental merging.
Queued/running jobs survive dispatcher restart and GPU eviction; fenced old attempts cannot replace resumed output.
Recent log finds prior answers/path/entity evidence, pins required backing packets and revalidates stale results.
Scout uses shared compact tools plus command/log, optional project scope and native skills; no injected overview/recursive delegation/paid fallback.
Sandbox command is no-network/read-only with useful scratch, bounded output, own-process cleanup and truthful coarse versus exact provenance.
Observer-only skill accepts optional name/hints, catalog and unscoped catalog routing; no separate list/read/context surface.
Agent is homed in registered skills root and follows native CUDA/Volta/atlas routes and prerequisites.
Broker exact-read text/hash/range equals canonical resource; out-of-range, changed selection and redacted resource never masquerade as verbatim.
Small synthesis is separate and evidence-linked; shared job/alias/queue/preemption implementation is reused.
Mutator can independently validate/diff/apply/amend/supersede/retire using canonical kernels; observer/coder cannot invoke these operations.
Normal no-op/retry/scoped freshness behavior avoids needless revisions or repeated approval, with real transactional postconditions.
Amend_project validates identity/relation/generator/provider/skill-use/orientation declarations and invalidates affected derived views.
Destructive effect classification requires fresh user permission and host safeguards; model flags or repository prose cannot self-authorize.
Maintenance preserves dirty work, successful proof and live ownership; exact grant/receipt replay returns current valid continuation.
Every profile exposes exactly surface.json names; forbidden hidden invocations and legacy aliases cannot bypass policy.
Extended is schema/dispatch observer-only; native roles do not advertise read/skill adapters or mandatory overview.
Delegate/collect implementations and state survive, but discovery/dispatch label them temporarily inactive with explicit reactivation.
New tools share services/envelopes and startup does not start models/reserve GPUs/scan all corpora; doctor and installed docs use new routing.
Observer orientation-to-batch-read, evidence and cross-project trace journey succeeds with genuine locators.
Coder and mutator native/task/planning journeys succeed without observer adapter or context tax.
Busy scout and skill authority journeys execute against real local inference with restart/eviction reuse.
Matched old/new journeys report total bytes/calls/retries/model usage/latency and no correctness or evidence loss.
Independent review and all required conformance cases have current executed evidence; no missing/skipped required product gates.
Paired runtime identity, standalone paired-release manifest and exact new role surfaces are verified on the installed candidate and live registration.
Rollback preserves forward state/queued jobs and prior launcher; no Todo database restoration over new work.
PCE2 affected work is reconciled and AS1 receipts current; unrelated source and paused NF1A remain untouched.
Additive kernel migration/read/export supports declarations and applied skill context with one authority and material revisions.
Typed plan amendments/registration/maintenance reuse transactions, preservation, replay and truthful evidence applicability.
Scoped coder publication and mutator project-wide declarations have distinct authority; derived indexes invalidate without manual edits.
Investigator/skill modes use one verified backend with job-scoped state and no task/child mutation authority.
Warm reuse, mode isolation, cooperative yields and bounded output work with durable broker attempt fencing.
Existing coding delegate/collect implementations/tests remain functional internally but native model routing marks them temporarily inactive.
Foreground CUDA work evicts only overlapping idle observer residency through the existing host-global interlock.
Quiescence/VRAM and physical lease release are observed before reassignment; live model processes cannot be expired away.
Active cooperative yield/restart retains job evidence; separate islands and unrelated foreground work remain intact.
Real installed multi-GPU eviction/reuse qualification leaves no residual model/test leases and discovers UUIDs/topology dynamically.
Native coder/mutator/scout guidance uses filesystem/command skill access, not removed observer adapters or injected overview.
Applied-versus-consulted skill publishing is integrated into normal context/handoff flow with source-bound route relevance.
CUDA/atlas technical bodies, IDs, edges, compendium and ZIP match captured baseline except explicitly justified routing-reference repairs.
Skill catalog and maps cover accessible installed skills and nested native routes, with explicit missing/unsupported entries.
Current canonical Todo/read/runtime identity and native workflows work against the Project Control surface candidate.
Real scout/skill/eviction journeys and preserved dormant coding delegation have executed evidence.
Producer receipts identify exact Skills authority/source/contracts and are consumed without foreign native dependency hacks.
An explicit paired-release manifest pins the qualified standalone Project Control and Skills releases; Skills contains no Project Control gitlink or source copy.
Bound installation/native instructions and rollback manifest are verified; queued state and user projects are preserved.

policy: Each required ID must be represented by executed passing runtime tests, not docs/schema-only checks where effects are required.
